description: This Dart source file defines an Authentication API client for interacting with FastAPI backend endpoints related to user authentication. It includes methods for login, OTP request/verification, signup, token refresh, and password reset, handling HTTP requests and responses with JSON encoding/decoding and error handling.

classes.name: AuthApi
classes.description: Client class for communicating with authentication-related endpoints on the backend API, managing request construction, authentication token handling, and response processing.

methods.name: AuthApi
methods.description: Constructor for setting the base URL configuration for API requests.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Constructs a complete Uri for a given API endpoint path.

methods.name: _jsonHeaders
methods.description: Generates HTTP headers with Content-Type and optional Authorization token.

methods.name: _handleJsonResponse
methods.description: Processes HTTP responses, decodes JSON, handles HTTP errors, and throws exceptions on failure.

methods.name: _postJson
methods.description: Performs a POST request with JSON body and handles the response.

methods.name: postJsonWithAuth
methods.description: Performs an authenticated POST request, refreshes token if expired, and retries once.

methods.name: loginWithPassword
methods.description: Logs in a user via phone/email and password, sending credentials to the backend.

methods.name: requestOtp
methods.description: Requests an OTP for login or signup purposes.

methods.name: verifyOtp
methods.description: Verifies an OTP code received by the user.

methods.name: signupWithPassword
methods.description: Signs up a new user with phone, email, password, and optional name, plus consent acceptance.

methods.name: refreshToken
methods.description: Refreshes authentication tokens using a refresh token.

methods.name: passwordResetRequest
methods.description: Initiates a password reset process by requesting a reset link or OTP.

methods.name: passwordResetConfirm
methods.description: Confirms password reset with OTP and sets a new password.
